name: moloco-mcp
description: Moloco Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented end

platform_mcp_moloco_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_MOLOCO_API_KEY
platform_mcp_moloco_api_key.description: Moloco Ads API key (Moloco Ads > account settings > API key; created for the ad account's workplace). Exchanged at POST https://api.moloco.cloud/cm/v1/auth/tokens {api_key} for a 16-hour bearer token, re-requested on expiry or 401.

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no current-user endpoint in the Campaign management API; the probe is GET /cm/v1/ad-accounts (ad accounts the token's user can access in the workplace).

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: GET /cm/v1/ad-accounts: all ad accounts accessible to the current user on the token's workplace.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: GET /cm/v1/campaigns?ad_account_id=…&states=… (states: SUBMITTED, READY, UPCOMING, ACTIVE, PAUSED, SUSPENDED, COMPLETED; deleted campaigns are excluded). The daily budget is in raw.budget_schedule.daily_schedule.daily_budget.amount_micros (micros of the account currency), so it is not mapped to `budget`; enabling_state ENABLED|DISABLED is in raw. `page`/`limit` are not sent.

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: POST /cm/v1/analytics-overview {ad_account_id, date_range {start, end}, dimensions [DATE, CAMPAIGN_ID, CAMPAIGN_TITLE], metrics [IMPRESSIONS, CLICKS, INSTALLS, CONVERSIONS, SPEND]} answers the rows synchronously; spend is in the ad account's currency. `campaign_id` is not applied (all campaigns of the account are returned, one row per day and campaign).
